about.missionDesc: Foster a culture of adoption and animal care within the campus of Instituto Tecnológico de Morelia, providing a transparent technological platform connecting students, staff, and rescuers to reduce abandonment and improve the quality of life of pets in our facilities.
about.visionDesc: To be the reference model in animal welfare management for all institutions of the Tecnológico Nacional de México, achieving a 'Zero Abandonment' campus through the integration of social technology and active community participation by 2026.
